fields.description: Eltiera Heights is Ellington’s first residential development in Jumeirah Islands. The tower combines one- to three-bedroom apartments with two four-bedroom penthouses. Shared spaces extend from landscaped arrival areas to an infinity-edge pool, fitness facilities and quieter spaces for work or relaxation.
